title: 학술원 사무국에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 고위공무원단 직위의 직무등급의 표시 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00024:20081231:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 학술원 사무국에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 고위공무원단 직위의 직무등급의 표시 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 24, December 31, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on January 1, 2009.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (9) Omitted.

(10) Part of the Rules on the Indication, etc. of Duty Grades of Positions Belonging to the Senior Civil Service among the Authorized Positions of Public Officials in the Secretariat of the National Academy of Sciences shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2, "Grade E" shall be replaced with "Grade B".
